values.note: Tiled bathhouses in every area; coin laundry in Areas 1, 2 and 4; Country Store with snack bar, pizza and groceries; honey-wagon tank service for a fee; pool and beach included in the rate.

facilities.source: https://www.mountainlakecampground.com/our-campground/faqs/ ('We also have dumping stations, or for a fee you can schedule our Honey Wagon service'; laundry 'coin-operated and are located in the Area #1, #2, and #4 bathhouses') + https://www.mountainlakecampground.com/our-campground/amenities/ (Country Store, Laundry Room), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Book on the operator's NewBook page or at 304-872-6222 (same-day arrivals after 5 pm by phone). 'Peak season weekends require a 2-night minimum stay. No Saturday check-ins or check-outs.' Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day need 3 nights. The booking page also put a 2-night minimum on the Area 4 lakefront sites for a June Tuesday. Reservations for the next season open Labor Day weekend. No refunds; cancel 14 days out to keep the deposit as credit.
